app_info.subtitle: Explore blockchain data
app_info.description: Explore blockchain data across SQD Portal datasets. Query Ethereum, Base, Solana, Polkadot, Bitcoin, and Hyperliquid. Discover Tron datasets and inspect their heads, freshness, and timestamps. Includes Pipes SDK and Squid SDK guidance.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the latest 200 Hyperliquid BTC fills.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the last 200 BTC perp fills on Hyperliquid.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the latest 200 BTC fills with time, direction, price, size, and trader fields.

test_cases.description: Measure recent transaction activity on Base.
test_cases.user_prompt: How many transactions landed on Base in the past 30 minutes?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns time buckets and a total transaction count for Base over the requested period.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the latest 20 USDC transfers on Base.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the latest 20 USDC transfers on Base from the past hour.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the latest 20 Base USDC transfers with sender, recipient, amount, time, and transaction hash.

test_cases.description: Discover the blockchain networks available through SQD.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which blockchain networks can SQD query?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a searchable list of supported networks and their availability.

test_cases.description: Summarize a public wallet's recent Base activity.
test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045 activity on Base over the past day.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns incoming and outgoing activity, counterparties, and clear time and network coverage.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger SQD for a request to send a transaction.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that SQD is read-only and cannot sign or send transactions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger SQD for a request to place a trade.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Place a Hyperliquid BTC trade for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that SQD can retrieve market data but cannot place or sign trades.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger SQD for price predictions or investment advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Predict tomorrow's BTC price and tell me whether to buy.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that SQD provides historical and live blockchain data, not predictions or investment advice.
